subject: Midwindow flight check: OKR status, suggested re-scope, and procurement unblock
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Midwindow flight check: OKR status, suggested re-scope, and procurement unblock

Team — quick midwindow readout and two asks before QBR prep week. Keeping it short:

High-level status
- OKR A (Serving runtime perf): On-track for latency SLAs, but token cost is 18% above target due to test workload spike.
- OKR B (Dedicated onboarding): 60% of customers migrated; two customers (Acme, EdgeScale) need reserved capacity approvals.
- OKR C (Optimize tooling): Eval harness rollout delayed by a week because the GPU quota for the staging pool is limited.

Proposed re-scope (short):
- Pause the extra internal experiments that add +8% token usage (low signal) for the next 6 weeks; focus infra efforts on batching improvements and cache coverage.
- Move two non-blocking telemetry expansions to the backlog for Q1.

Two asks (action items):
1) Procurement unblock: Acme has pushed the reserved capacity purchase (see attached MAP draft). Need procurement to expedite the PO/commit so we can stand up their dedicated pool before their pilot on Nov 1. Acme procurement contact is included in this thread.
2) Leadership decision on re-scope: Markus/Marissa — approve the temporary experiment pause so infra can redirect effort to KV cache and batching (estimated latency/cost benefit in attachment).

Attachments: 20261009-OKR-snapshot.pdf, mutual-action-plan-draft.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1QBR-OKR-Pack

I can be on a short sync if you want to walk the numbers — propose 30 minutes today at 4pm PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategy, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Midwindow flight check: OKR status, suggested re-scope, and procurement unblock

Vanessa — thanks for the concise readout. Two quick points:

1) On the re-scope: I support pausing low-signal experiments short-term but need a clear list of which two telemetry expansions you propose moving to backlog (cost of rollback if needed). Can you send a 1-pager that lists impact, owners, and rollback risk?

2) On procurement: if Acme needs the reserved pool by Nov 1, procurement will need a signed SOW + PO. Marissa — can you confirm sales has the final SOW signed? If not, we should prioritize that before procurement engages.

If we agree, I will greenlight the reallocation of one engineering sprint from experiments to batching work.

—Markus
VP, Product

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Midwindow flight check: OKR status, suggested re-scope, and procurement unblock

Markus / Vanessa — quick replies:

- SOW status: Sales has the countersigned SOW from Acme as of this morning (see HubSpot #ACME-4591). I attached the SOW stub in the MAP draft and flagged the delivery milestones. We still need the PO from Acme procurement to confirm the reserved capacity start date.

- Re-scope 1-pager: Attached is a 1-page summary (embedded in the MAP spreadsheet) listing the three experiments I recommend pausing. Quick summary here:
  * Experiment X: +3% token cost, low cohort lift — pause (owner: infra/exp-team).
  * Experiment Y: +2.5% token cost, has alternative telemetry; pause until after pilot (owner: telemetry).
  * Telemetry Expansion Z: low product visibility gains — move to backlog Q1 (owner: product-eng).

Estimated upside if we pause now: ~12–15% token unit cost reduction over 6 weeks and capacity reclaimed for staging tests.

I will ping procurement to move the PO along; Vanessa — can you loop Acme procurement contact on the next note and confirm final invoice terms?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Acme Procurement <procure@acme-corp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Jensen <alice@edgescale.io>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Midwindow flight check: OKR status, suggested re-scope, and procurement unblock

Hi Vanessa / Marissa — this is Acme procurement. Thanks for the MAP draft — we reviewed and have two clarifying asks before we can issue PO:

1) Can you confirm start-of-service date for the reserved pool (we propose Nov 8 if our billing cycle needs that buffer)?
2) We need a short note on data residency and audit log retention (SOC2 controls) for legal. Can you point us to the relevant artifact or provide a 1-paragraph confirmation?

Once we have those two items, I can push the PO through our system and target Nov 8 start.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Acme Analytics
procure@acme-corp.com

On Sun, Oct 11, 2026 at 08:15 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks — attaching SOC2 artifact and proposed start date in the MAP (Nov 8).
> Vanessa
